jobs.description: Skip to content Solutions Remote Data Intelligence On-site Reality Capture AI Engineering Utility Services Industries & Clients About Projects Insights Careers Connect Menu Remote Data Intelligence Start with everything already known. Our proprietary AI uncovers and connects public project intelligence—from utility records and as-builts to geotechnical reports, satellite imagery, permits, and more—creating a reliable, analysis-ready map with fully traceable insights. ExoInfo ExoInfo Accelerate project delivery by surfacing the unknowns before anyone steps on site. Every infrastructure project contains hidden risks—unknown utilities, undocumented assets, conflicting records, stakeholder agreements, environmental constraints, and forgotten permits. No single dataset reveals the full picture, and traditional research is time- and labor-intensive while still leaving critical gaps. ExoInfo combines proprietary AI with the expertise of planners and engineers to rapidly discover, organize, and analyze every available source of project intelligence before a single crew mobilizes. By transforming fragmented information into a single, traceable view of your project, ExoInfo uncovers hidden conflicts, identifies critical risks, and delivers source-linked CAD and GIS intelligence that enables faster and more informed planning, design, and decision-making. jobs.title: On-site Reality Capture
jobs.description: Skip to content Solutions Remote Data Intelligence On-site Reality Capture AI Engineering Utility Services Industries & Clients About Projects Insights Careers Connect Menu On-site Reality Capture Where records end, ground truth begins. Using advanced, non-intrusive scanning technologies and AI-powered analysis, we reveal utilities, subsurface features, and geotechnical conditions—creating a comprehensive understanding of site conditions above and below ground. Utility Mapping Foundation Mapping Geotech Mapping Targeted Validation Utility Mapping Redefining SUE with AI-powered insights and 3D models. Underground utilities are often poorly documented, inaccurately mapped, or completely unknown, creating costly risks for design, construction, and infrastructure projects. Exodigo is redefining how Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) is performed. Our non-intrusive Utility Mapping captures and analyzes high-density subsurface data to deliver comprehensive, engineering-ready utility maps and 3D digital deliverables with unmatched accuracy. By combining advanced sensing, cloud-based AI analysis, and veteran engineering expertise, Exodigo identifies underground infrastructure other methods miss—reducing risk, minimizing excavation, and enabling confident design decisions. View Projects Talk to an Expert 30% more utilities found on average compared to traditional locating methods across all Exodigo projects Up to 90% less intrusive investigation, limiting the need to test hole only where it matters most 1,000x more data captured with Exodigo sensors than conventional locators through high-density, systematic scanning Up to 90% mapping accuracy for non-intrusive, versus 80% with traditional SUE methods 86.1M+ square feet scanned across complex infrastructure environments Millions of subsurface scenarios analyzed per site using AI-driven modeling Months of utility analysis compressed into hours through AI-powered processing QL-B+ ASCE 38-22 QL-B utility mapping standard, with added depth intelligence for 3D design Signals & sensors Scanning equipment built for every terrain. No two sites are the same. Our proprietary scanning equipment is designed to capture high-quality subsurface data across any environment—without disruption. ExoCart Multi-sensor surveying | Comprehensive site coverage Exodigo’s primary multi-sensor platform, designed to deliver comprehensive underground data across a wide range of solid-ground environments. ExoDrone Aerial surveying | Large or hard-to-access areas Covers expansive or inaccessible terrain with rapid, efficient data capture from above ExoBackpack Mobile surveying | Rough or constrained environments Provides flexibility and mobility in complex environments such as residential areas, uneven terrain, or limited-access sites. ExoRoad Roadway surveying | Active roads Vehicle-mounted system designed to collect data efficiently while minimizing traffic disruption and reducing permitting requirements. ExoRail Rail corridor surveying | Active rail lines Enables non-disruptive data collection along live rail infrastructure, supporting safe and continuous operations. ExoPile Foundation surveying | Pile-supported structures Specialized seismic sensing system that non-destructively characterizes pile-supported structures and foundation elements. Setting a new standard Solve utility challenges before they become project risks. Prevent Utility Strikes & Safety Incidents Locate buried utilities with greater accuracy to reduce the risk of damaging critical infrastructure during excavation and construction. Identify Utility Conflicts Early Reveal utility crossings, congestion, depth constraints, and subsurface conflicts before design is finalized, enabling better routing decisions and reducing redesigns. Reduce Project Costs & Schedule Risk Deliver comprehensive utility intelligence upfront to minimize rework, accelerate project delivery, reduce field investigations, and avoid costly construction delays. Minimize Operational Disruption Collect high-density utility data non-intrusively while reducing impacts to traffic, rail operations, businesses, and surrounding communities. Optimize Field Validation & Excavation Reduce unnecessary test holes and exploratory excavation by focusing QL-A investigations only where additional validation is required. Create a Single Source of Truth Transform fragmented records into GIS- and CAD-ready intelligence that improves collaboration across owners, designers, utility coordinators, engineers, and construction teams. How it works Complete utility intelligence. No digging. No disruption. Sensor Scanning Input Multichannel Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) Detects buried utilities, voids, and non-metallic infrastructure using radar. Electro-Magnetic (EM) Locates conductive utilities including powerlines, tracer wires, and metal pipes Magnetic Detects buried ferrous metals, tanks, casings, and steel infrastructure Metal Detector Pinpoints shallow metallic utilities, markers, and buried infrastructure components Thermal & Spectral Identifies subsurface anomalies through heat signatures and surface material changes Intelligence Output Comprehensive Utility Mapping Detected utility locations, depth ranges, material types, and classifications Comparison & Verification Identifies new utilities and verifies or corrects existing records Conflict Identification Detects design conflicts using surface and subsurface infrastructure intelligence Subsurface Risk Identification Unknown utilities, anomalies, voids, and potential construction hazards Surface & Access Features Manholes, hydrants, valves, handholes, and visible infrastructure indicators How it works Complete utility intelligence. jobs.description: Skip to content Solutions Remote Data Intelligence On-site Reality Capture AI Engineering Utility Services Industries & Clients About Projects Insights Careers Connect Menu AI Engineering Turn intelligence into execution. Using AI-powered automation and digital engineering workflows, we transform project intelligence and ground truth into design-ready deliverables, engineering models, and digital twins. Digitization & Modeling Services Design Services Digitization & Modeling Services Bring project intelligence to life with 3D maps and digital twins. Project information is often trapped in legacy records, disconnected systems, and inaccessible formats. Exodigo transforms existing data, collected intelligence, and proposed designs into engineering-grade digital deliverables that teams can visualize, analyze, and act upon. Combining AI-powered automation with engineering, geospatial, and BIM expertise, we deliver accurate 2D and 3D models, digital twins, BIM, GIS, and CAD deliverables that improve coordination, accelerate decision-making, identify conflicts earlier, and create a lasting digital foundation for infrastructure programs. Transform subsurface intelligence, existing-condition data, and project information into engineering-grade maps and models delivered in client-preferred formats, including BIM, GIS, CAD, augmented reality environments, and stamp-and-sealed drawings. These deliverables provide a coordinated foundation for planning, design, construction, utility coordination, and asset management. By combining AI-powered automation with engineering and BIM expertise, fragmented project information becomes structured digital assets that accelerate design development, improve constructability, and support modern digital delivery and asset management initiatives. Single Source of Truth Build a smarter foundation for every project. Integrate Seamlessly Into Client Workflows Support owner, designer, and contractor teams with outputs that fit into their existing BIM, GIS, CAD, and digital twin environments—reducing friction, reformatting, and handoff challenges. Accelerate Design and Coordination Give project teams a coordinated starting point that reduces manual drafting, speeds up design development, and improves collaboration across disciplines. Leverage validated utility intelligence to develop reliable relocation budgets, align stakeholders, and execute utility relocations with confidence from planning through construction. Utility Services Utility Services Turn utility insights into actionable relocation and coordination plans. Identifying utility conflicts is only the first step. Resolving them is what keeps projects moving forward. Exodigo's Utility Services help project teams transform utility intelligence into reliable cost estimates and coordinated execution plans. Leveraging validated utility data and conflict analysis, we support informed decision-making, realistic budgeting, and alignment among utility owners, operators, agencies, designers, and project stakeholders. Talk to an Expert Our Utility Services Solutions 0. 1 / Utility Relocation Cost Estimation 0. 2 / Utility Relocation Coordination Utility Relocation Cost Estimation Budget with confidence before relocation design begins. Develop early-stage utility relocation cost forecasts using validated utility information, regional unit costs, engineering-informed assumptions, and project-specific inputs. Our estimates provide reliable budgeting and funding guidance, including quantity takeoffs and confidence-based cost ranges (P10, P50, P90), helping teams manage risk and establish contingencies long before final relocation designs are complete. Utility Relocation Coordination Keep utility relocations moving forward. Align utility owners, operators, public agencies, designers, contractors, and project teams around a shared understanding of relocation requirements, schedules, and priorities. Through proactive coordination, communication, and progress tracking, we help resolve conflicts faster and keep relocation activities—and projects—moving forward. jobs.title: Accessibility Statement
jobs.description: Skip to content Solutions Remote Data Intelligence On-site Reality Capture AI Engineering Utility Services Industries & Clients About Projects Insights Careers Connect Menu Accessibility Statement Exodigo is committed to making our website as accessible as possible to everyone, including people with disabilities. We're constantly working towards improving the accessibility of our website https://www.exodigo.com/ (“ Website ”) to ensure we provide equal access to all of our users. Wherever possible, our Website meets the standards set by the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.2 level AA). Measures to support accessibility Our mission is to be able to support the widest array of browsers and assistive technologies as possible. We have therefore invested efforts to support popular systems with high market share, including Windows /IOS/ Android and the major browsers as Chrome Safari, Edge, and Firefox. In addition, the following modifications were made during the audit to make this Website accessible: Headings and Semantic Structure : Our content is organized using proper headings and semantic tags, making it easier for screen readers and assistive technologies to interpret and present information. Color Contrast : We maintain sufficient color contrast between text and background elements to enhance readability for users with visual impairments. Keyboard Navigation : Our website is built to be operable by keyboard and using a modern screen reader and speech recognition software, ensuring that individuals who rely on keyboard input or assistive technologies can access all content and functionality. Text alternatives for non-text content : We aim to provide appropriate text alternatives for meaningful images, icons, and other non-text content so that users of screen readers and similar assistive technologies can access the information conveyed. Text resizing and responsive display : We seek to support text resizing, browser zoom of up to 200%, and responsive layouts so that content remains readable and usable across devices and display settings. Feedback Despite our efforts to make site browsing accessible for people with disabilities, some pages may yet be accessible, or the appropriate technological solution has not yet been found it is possible that some pages or sections on this website have human mistakes, for a variety of reasons. We are dedicated to improving the accessibility features and interface of our product. Notice something wrong? You are most welcome to reach out to us at info.exodigo.ai. Third-Party Content While we strive to ensure our website's accessibility, some content or features may be provided by third-party platforms or external sources beyond our direct control. We encourage these providers to comply with accessibility standards, but we cannot guarantee their accessibility. Contact us It is our intention to resolve any complaint to your satisfaction, however, should you have any questions about our accessibility policy, including if you experience difficulty accessing our Website content, please contact us to info@exodigo.ai.
